title: Defibrillators
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Device-neutral educational specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.

safety_concepts.text: Perform and call a safety check so nobody touches the patient or bed at the moment of shock; do not defibrillate during manual chest compressions, even with gloves.
Pads are preferred over paddles when available; if paddles are used apply firm force and good contact to limit arcing.
Keep the pre-shock pause as short as possible: compressions continue while the defibrillator charges; a coordinated team can complete manual defibrillation with under 5 seconds of interruption.

escalation_concepts.text: Call for help early; follow the oxygen-safety steps in unit policy during defibrillation.

sources.use: ERC ALS 2025 (paraphrase only; commercial use needs ERC agreement)

required_sources: Source explaining each listed monitored parameter in device-neutral terms
The operator's manual for the specific model and software version the unit uses (identify it by name and version; do not reproduce its screens or alarm tables)
gaps: Parameter explanations are written only where a source read says something about the parameter; the rest stay unexplained (needs_source).
Safety, monitoring and escalation statements are reused from the matching skill draft and carry that draft's evidence support, not clinical review.
Any manufacturer-specific behaviour is excluded until a named model and software version, and permission to use its documentation, are available.
permissions: Cited sources are paraphrased only; see the licensing register. No proprietary screens, alarm tables or manuals are reproduced.
